items.title: FREE STREAM: The Transfer Show on Sky Sports News
Birmingham Phoenix win battle to avoid Hundred wooden spoon vs MI London
items.description: Birmingham Phoenix prevailed in the battle to avoid the wooden spoon in The Hundred women's competition as Ellyse Perry's composed half-century condemned MI London to a sixth defeat of a chastening campaign.

items.title: McIlroy keen to asses his game during first FedExCup Playoffs event
items.description: Rory McIlroy believes this week's FedEx St. Jude Championship will be a good chance for him to assess the current standard of his game, as the Northern Irishman returns to PGA Tour action for the first time since The Open.

items.title: Guimaraes on bench as Arsenal face Como LIVE!
Can Mourinho restore Real Madrid to former glory?
items.description: Jose Mourinho is back at Real Madrid 13 years after leaving the club. But can the 63-year-old recapture the success of his first spell and deliver trophies at the Bernabeu? BBC Sport speaks to those who know Mourinho and Real Madrid best to assess whether his second stint can be a success.

items.title: Rangers seek striker & are 'playing with fire' in defence
items.description: Rangers are being "proactive" in seeking a new striker after Youssef Chermiti was ruled out long term, says manager Derek McInnes, who warns defensive injuries leave the club "playing with fire".

items.title: What's happening with Lewis-Skelly's Arsenal future?
items.description: Myles Lewis-Skelly's long-term future at Arsenal has been debated since he slipped down the pecking order last season - will he stay with the Gunners with interest reportedly shown elsewhere?

items.title: Everton double up vs wide open Newcastle LIVE!
O'Sullivan's poor start to season continues with early China Open loss
items.description: Ronnie O'Sullivan's poor start to the new season continued after he lost 6-4 to Noppon Saengkham in the second round of the China Open.

items.title: Lakers to be sold in record-breaking £9bn deal
items.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are set to be sold for a record-breaking $12.5bn (£9.25bn) to Josh Kushner, the venture capitalist who was at the centre of FIFA's proposed new commercial structure.

items.title: Arsenal reignite interest in Aston Villa's Konsa
items.description: Aston Villa's central defender Ezri Konsa is thought to be Arsenal's preferred option in their search for a new central defender.
